channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Amazon is phasing out Fire HD tablets, but not without some big discounts first
item.description: Amazon recently announced it’s phasing out its Fire HD tablets in favor of much pricier Alexa Tablets. While the days of getting an affordable, but good tablet from Amazon seem to be coming to an end, you can still get a fantastic deal on the ad-supported Amazon Fire HD 10. It has dropped to a […]

item.title: Hisense U6SF Pro review: a richly hued mini-LED TV with strong features, especially for the price
item.description: The Hisense U6SF Pro is a solid TV that gets you most of the way there for a good price.

item.title: JustWatch now streams TV shows and movies, too
item.description: After announcing plans to introduce its own streaming service last month, JustWatch, a popular guide and search engine for finding things to watch on existing platforms like Disney Plus and Netflix, launched JustWatch TV today. The new streaming service offers an ad-supported free subscription, an ad-free paid subscription, and movie rentals with content from 30 […]...

item.title: Microsoft reportedly plans Xbox handheld in 2027, next-gen console in 2028
item.description: Microsoft is reportedly planning to launch an Xbox "next-generation handheld device" for the holiday season of 2027. The Xbox next-gen console, codename Project Helix, would then launch in the holidays of 2028, according to a new report from Fortune. The report doesn't make it clear whether the handheld would be made by a manufacturer like […]

item.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
item.description: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

item.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
item.description: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

item.title: DeepSeek AI tools banned from US government agency systems as rift with China grows
item.description: DeepSeek was labeled as carrying "multiple threat vectors".

item.title: How long can you expect your original Steam Deck to last?
item.description: The original Steam Deck has been around for a while, but unless you only play the heaviest games, it should be great for some time more.

item.title: Russia drafted plans for AI that could block 95% of VPNs — but the idea has quietly vanished from its national roadmap
item.description: The machine-learning filter it would have relied on is funded separately, and the experts consulted expect it to catch plenty of legitimate traffic as well.

item.title: AMD is bringing its next-gen FSR 4.1 upscaling tech to Xbox
item.description: Coming soon to the X/S and Ally devices.

item.title: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web
item.description: Meta says it paused a Muse feature that lets you share conversations with the AI assistant after researchers found the URLs publicly available on the web, as reported by Ars Technica. In a report published this week, researchers at the security firm Claroc say they found more than 6,800 Muse links through public DNS records. […]

item.title: Du jamais-vu dans l'Univers : les astronomes révèlent une étoile verte aux couleurs presque psychédéliques
item.description: Des astronomes ont-ils pris du LSD ? Non, mais la découverte de certaines naines blanches pourrait être considérée comme celle d'une version naturelle de l'art psychédélique…

item.title: Just Eat's AI images trial has exposed a much bigger problem with AI
item.description: Just Eat pauses trial of AI-generated images for menu items after unfortunate bacon and eggs in a fizzy drink image.

item.title: How often should you restart your Apple Watch?
item.description: Your Apple Watch doesn't need frequent restarts like a computer, but you might still want to shut down when something's off.

item.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
item.description: The former Google CEO owns about 1% stake in the leading AI lab, Bloomberg reported.

item.title: The $20,000 Voxel bot will help you find misplaced things around your home
item.description: Tuesday Labs, a New York City-based robotics lab and design studio, has opened reservations for Voxel, its new bi-pedal robot designed to learn and take over routine tasks throughout your home. Similar to other robots like Weave Robotics' Issac 1 that are designed for household chores beyond mopping or vacuuming floors, Voxel features a pair […]

item.title: Love Is Blind Season 11: Here’s the cast and their Instagram profiles
item.description: Meet the Boston singles looking for love in Netflix’s ‘Love Is Blind’ Season 11, including their jobs, zodiac signs, and Instagrams.

item.title: French Government Calls Emergency Meetings With Platforms Over Protests
item.description: TikTok and other sites were told to curb protest footage and AI-altered images, while online retailers like Vinted and eBay reportedly signed an agreement stop looted goods from flooding resale sites.

item.title: Millions of California students have sensitive data stolen — names, SSIDs, home addresses and more taken in attack on nonprofit
item.description: Data breach likely saw attackers obtain millions of students' PII via a simple password compromise, it seems.

item.title: TikTok, Snapchat, Telegram : la France peut-elle vraiment couper l’accès aux réseaux sociaux ?
item.description: Gabriel Attal propose de bloquer temporairement les réseaux sociaux dans les zones touchées par les violences survenues en marge des mobilisations du 17 octobre. Une idée qui revient à chaque crise. Mais un tel blocage est-il seulement possible techniquement ?

item.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
item.description: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

item.title: Spotify is dancing around its AI 'slop and spam' problem
item.description: The company said it removed 50 million such tracks from recommendations, but hasn't necessarily wiped them entirely.
